evidence: FFD, BFD, and exact pairing all achieved 8 bins (optimal). Random ordering with first-fit produced 9-10 bins in 15 trials. Items form perfect complementary pairs (9+1, 8+2, 7+3, 6+4) that fill capacity-10 bins exactly.
statement: When all items form exact complementary pairs summing to bin capacity, any weight-based ordering (FFD, BFD) achieves optimal packing; random ordering consistently produces one extra bin.
